name: Durable Prospective Project-Universe Membership Capture
principles: capture only states that are actually observed prospectively
the exact triggering universe bytes are the evidence source even if main advances later
identical universe content hashes do not create repeated membership observations
observation time is the actual capture time and is never backdated to source-effective dates
raw source bytes and normalized membership snapshot are both retained
all persistent membership events remain append-only and hash chained
listing venue tradability and investability remain separate evidence classes
workflow archive commits must not alter productive scanner inputs or outputs
